result.instructions: Tools for Tookan, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tookan data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run tookan_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tookan_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tookan_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. tookan_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The connected Tookan account (admin user): user_id, email, name, company name and address. Good first call. POST /v2/get_user_details.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (Tookan calls them jobs) of one task type within a date range of the task date (at most 31 days, within the last 31 days). Paginated: one Tookan page per call (page, default 1). Filter by status, agent (fleet_id), team, customer, job ids or your order ids. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted/acknowledged, 8 declined, 9 cancelled, 10 deleted. POST /v2/get_all_tasks.

job_type.description: Task type: 0 = pickup, 1 = delivery, 2 = appointment, 3 = field workforce (FOS).

start_date.description: Start of the task-date range, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: End of the task-date range, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 31 days after start_date).

job_status.description: Only tasks in this status. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted/acknowledged, 8 declined, 9 cancelled, 10 deleted.

fleet_id.description: Only tasks of this agent (from list_agents).

team_id.description: Only tasks of this team (from list_teams).

customer_id.description: Only tasks of this customer (from list_customers).

order_ids.description: Only tasks with these order ids (your own reference).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Tookan pages are a fixed size.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.title: Get task details
tools.description: Full details of up to 100 tasks by job id: customer, addresses, agent (fleet_id/fleet_name), status, timestamps (started/arrived/completed), tracking link, custom fields; optionally the status history. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted/acknowledged, 8 declined, 9 cancelled, 10 deleted. POST /v2/get_job_details.

tools.name: get_tasks_by_order_id
tools.title: Get tasks by order id
tools.description: Full details of the tasks carrying the given order ids (the reference you set when creating a task). POST /v2/get_job_details_by_order_id.

tools.name: get_task_stats
tools.title: Task statistics
tools.description: Task counts per status (e.g. successful vs failed), optionally for one task type, one team and a date range. Task status codes: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 in progress/arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted/acknowledged, 8 declined, 9 cancelled, 10 deleted. POST /v2/user_task_stats.

job_type.description: Task type: 0 = pickup, 1 = delivery, 2 = appointment, 3 = field workforce (FOS).

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (drivers / field workers; Tookan calls them fleets) with fleet_id, name, phone, tags, team and live status (0 available, 1 offline, 2 busy). Filter by name, tags, availability or fleet ids. The API returns the whole list; this tool returns a window (limit/offset, next_offset). POST /v2/get_all_fleets.

name.description: Only agents whose name matches this text.

match_any_tag.description: With tags: true = agents having ANY of the tags, false = ALL of them.

status.description: 0 = only free agents, 1 = only busy agents.

offset.description: Items to skip (use next_offset from the previous call).

tools.name: get_agent
tools.title: Get agent profile
tools.description: One agent's profile (name, email, phone, tags, transport, location, rating, active state) and current tasks. Only profile fields are returned; app tokens and password hashes never are. POST /v2/view_fleet_profile.

tools.name: get_agent_location
tools.title: Get agent location
tools.description: An agent's last known coordinates (latitude/longitude). POST /v2/get_fleet_location.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (team_id, name, address, tags). With include_agents, each team also lists its agents. Returns a window (limit/offset, next_offset). POST /v2/view_all_team_only (or /v2/view_teams with agents).

include_agents.description: Also return each team's agents (larger reply).

offset.description: Items to skip (use next_offset from the previous call).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (customer_id, name, phone, email, address), optionally searched by name or phone. Paginated: one Tookan page per call (page, default 1). POST /v2/get_all_customers.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Tookan pages are a fixed size.

tools.name: find_customer_by_phone
tools.title: Find customer by phone
tools.description: Find customers by exact phone number. POST /v2/find_customer_with_phone.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get customer profile
tools.description: One customer's profile (contact details, address, coordinates). POST /v2/view_customer_profile.

tools.name: create_delivery_task
tools.title: Create a delivery task
tools.description: WRITE: create a delivery task (job) for a customer address, due by job_delivery_datetime in the given timezone. Optionally assign it to an agent (fleet_id) or team, or let Tookan auto-assign it within the team. Returns job_id and tracking link. Always uses the address given here, not one saved for the customer's phone (ignore_customer_lat_long 1). POST /v2/create_task (has_pickup 0, has_delivery 1, layout_type 0).

job_delivery_datetime.description: Deliver before this local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

timezone.description: Minutes to ADD to local time to get UTC (Tookan's convention): IST = -330, CET = -60, EST = 300, PST = 480.

order_id.description: Your own reference for the task.

latitude.description: Delivery latitude (else Tookan geocodes the address).

team_id.description: Team to put the task in (from list_teams).

fleet_id.description: Agent to assign the task to (from list_agents).

auto_assignment.description: Let Tookan auto-assign the task to an agent of team_id.

tags.description: Comma-separated agent tags used by auto-assignment.

tools.name: assign_agent_to_task
tools.title: Assign an agent to a task
tools.description: WRITE: assign (or reassign) a task to an agent of a team; replaces any previous agent. Notifies the agent unless notify is false (so repeating the call notifies again). POST /v2/assign_fleet_to_task.

annotations.title: Assign an agent to a task

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.title: Update task status
tools.description: WRITE (DESTRUCTIVE): force a task's status, overriding the agent app. Completing (2 successful, 3 failed) or cancelling (9) closes the task and notifies per the account's settings; confirm with the user first. Deleting (10) is not offered. Settable: 0 assigned, 1 started, 2 successful, 3 failed, 4 arrived, 6 unassigned, 7 accepted, 8 declined, 9 cancelled. POST /v2/update_task_status.

job_status.description: New status code (0-4, 6-9; 10 deleted is not allowed).
